description: DIAKRISIS coherence-measure constants and monitor thresholds (spec §2.7, §6). All for the base 7-cell unless noted.

coherence_measures.comment: Gamma_net = C/N (C = correlation matrix, unit diagonal). Phi = sum_{i!=j}|g_ij|^2 / sum_i g_ii^2; P = Tr(Gamma^2); R = 1/(N*P).

equicorrelated_stratum.comment: All off-diagonal correlations equal to r. These closed forms are verified against the matrix measures (V15).

leading_indicator.comment: V17: on the physical domain (Gamma PSD, Tr=1) the failure region {P < 2/N} is contained in {Phi < 1}. The integration alarm fires no later than the structure alarm.

collective_subject_window.comment: V19: a 7-agent cell is a candidate unified subject iff its mean inter-agent correlation lies in this half-open interval.

first_order_blindness.comment: V11: the sum of the seven Fano line-adjacency matrices equals J - I (the complete graph K7). Its spectrum makes pairwise monitoring structure-blind.

partition_fiedler.comment: V14: algebraic connectivity (second-smallest Laplacian eigenvalue) of the health-weighted collinearity graph.

self_healing.comment: V16, §6.7-6.8. Each coarse cross-segment hop contracts coherences by 1/3, hence integration Phi by 1/9. Diagnosis has a floor at one third of cycles.

stability_radius.comment: T-104, corrected 2026-08-07. The Bures distance from the cell's state to the viability shell {P = 2/N} — the input to the DDoS shed law and the gauge an operator reads. TWO forms ship on purpose: a closed runtime form the homeostat STEERS on, and an exact form used only to REPORT. Values below are the base 7-cell.

runtime_form.comment: Band coordinates: r = K(N) * (sqrt(Phi) - 1) / sqrt(N). Error <=1.13% across the window and <0.01% at the wall, which is where the shed law needs it. Keys are prefixed because this file is read by a flat `"key": number` scan that takes the FIRST numeric match — an unprefixed `at_phi_star` in both forms would make the exact one unreachable.

exact_form.comment: The one-dominant family's exact Bures distance, machine-exact to 1e-14. This is what the telemetry snapshot and the fanos_coherence_stability_radius gauge must reproduce.

root.comment: THE LOAD-BEARING INVARIANT. Both forms are exactly zero on P <= 2/N and only there. It is why every claim that reads only the root — the fault-count table, the tolerated fault fraction — survived the correction untouched, while every claim about the curve's SHAPE had to be redone. Pin the root and that reasoning is checkable rather than a note in a doc.

setpoint.comment: The max-min point of the runtime metric: the band has two opposite failures, so the robust point maximises the SMALLER distance. Equalising them gives sqrt(Phi*) = (1+sqrt2)/2. The scale K/sqrt(N) cancels in the balance, so Phi* is the same on every plane — by proof, not coincidence.
setpoint.half_the_ceiling: r(Phi*) == max_stability_radius / 2, exactly, in the runtime metric

refuted_form.comment: NEGATIVE VECTOR — this is what the law is NOT. Pinning only the right answer does not stop someone re-deriving the wrong one, and this exact surd shipped for months. It was cited to Fuchs-van de Graaf; the chain bounds d_B from ABOVE through the trace norm while delta-P lives in L2 geometry, and an inequality the wrong way round was asserted as an equality.
refuted_form.overstates_at_the_wall: 81.7x at Phi = 1.0007; 4.57x at the setpoint; the error DIVERGES because the true law is linear in eps = P - 2/N while the surd is eps^(1/2)
refuted_form.not_uniformly_wrong: overstates the ceiling 2.61x at N=7 and 1.73x at N=57, but UNDERSTATES at N=993 (0.0317 against the true 0.0369) — the two laws cross, so rescaling the old numbers errs in both directions
